Screen with `python tools/gdl/tests/test_t21_placeholder_name_guard.py` and with a census of config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt for a bare `fn`/`lbl`/`jumptable` symbol (measured 0 at 0f4151839). subject: tool:gdl-memory-graph
value: dtk suffixes LOCAL symbol names with their address so the target's `long2str_800E74B8` pairs with our static `long2str`, and every tool here strips `_80XXXXXX` to make that pairing. For a name whose PREFIX is a placeholder kind the suffix IS the identity, and the strip collapses the whole population to a single key: `fn_800D967C` -> `fn`, `lbl_8023D000` -> `lbl`, `jumptable_80118904` -> `jumptable`. THE PROJECT ALREADY KNEW THIS FOR HALF THE CASES: cs_constsweep._strip_dtk records "fndiff learned this the hard way: stripping collapsed every pool label to bare 'lbl'", and matchtool.parse, fnskel, cv_crossjoin.key, rs_composed_census and fndiff.parse's FUNCTION-NAME path all carry an `if not name.startswith('fn_')` guard. THREE PLACES DID NOT, and each is a different failure mode. (1) probe.py computed `fn_stripped` unguarded at three sites and passed it ALONE to raw_word_residual, so `probe --raw` could never print a raw word count for any `fn_*` name and printed a fallback asserting the one conclusion that removes a function from every postprocessor class (claim.law.MP_probe-raw-drops-the-raw-word-count-for-every-address-suffixed-name-and-its-tu-gate-false-alarms-on-a-pinned-tu.20260903.v1). MEASURED over the 1,641 function names in the 53 raw postprocess bodies `--raw` scores: 275 names match the strip regex and 275 of 275 (100%) are `fn_*`; 260 are measurable under the FULL spelling and not the stripped one (POSITIVES), 0 the other way (NEGATIVES), 15 are genuinely count-asymmetric. (2) fndiff.parse's RELOCATION strip guarded `lbl` and `jumptable` and never added `fn`, so 2,004 relocations across 641 objects recorded their callee as the bare symbol `fn`: calling the WRONG unnamed function was invisible to `--clean`, to `real` and to the wf_word_diff RELOC-SYMBOL screen alike, which is the class claim.law.SA_a-wrong-global-that-shares-an-instruction-word-is-invisible-to-every-score-including-the-word-count.20260902.v1 exists for. CALIBRATED TWO-SIDED over all 3,032 comparable function pairs in 257 units: 0 pairs equal-today-and-differing-with-the-guard, 0 the other way — so this is a BLIND SPOT closed, not a live miscall repaired, and no lane pays a re-baseline for it. (3) fndiff.symbol_addresses registered its stripped ALIASES unguarded: of the 4,713 symbols.txt names the regex touches, 4,686 are placeholder names and they minted exactly three keys — `lbl` from 4,282 names, `fn` from 307, `jumptable` from 97 — each resolving to whichever name parsed first. THE RULE: strip the dtk suffix only from a name that does NOT begin with a placeholder prefix, and derive the guard from one shared constant rather than repeating the tuple, because the two copies in fndiff had already drifted apart by one element.
